data.sql: SELECT credits FROM players WHERE player_id = @{admin_player_id};

tests.name: Configure deterministic taxable activity on an owned test planet

data.sql: UPDATE planets SET owner_type = 'player', owner_id = @{admin_player_id} WHERE planet_id = 1;

tests.name: Enable ten percent tax for the test planet

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_tax_policies (planet_id, rate_bps, enabled) VALUES (1, 1000, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET rate_bps = 1000, enabled = TRUE;

tests.name: Clear prior assessment and fixture activity

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_tax_assessments WHERE planet_id = 1 AND tax_date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;
DELETE FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE idempotency_key = 'v2-taxation-e2e-planet-1';

INSERT INTO planet_economic_activity (planet_id, activity_type, commodity_code, quantity, unit_value, taxable_value, idempotency_key) VALUES (1, 'market_trade', 'ORE', 10, 1000, 10000, 'v2-taxation-e2e-planet-1');
UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'daily_planet_tax';

SELECT p.credits - @{credits_before}, ta.tax_amount, ta.taxable_value FROM players p JOIN planet_tax_assessments ta ON ta.owner_type = 'player' AND ta.owner_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_id = @{admin_player_id} AND ta.planet_id = 1 AND ta.tax_date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;
SELECT credits FROM players WHERE player_id = @{admin_player_id};
UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'daily_planet_tax';

tests.name: Verify a repeated task does not credit twice

data.sql: SELECT credits - @{credits_after_first} FROM players WHERE player_id = @{admin_player_id};

tests.name: Choose a second planet and corporation

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE planet_id <> 1 ORDER BY planet_id LIMIT 1), (SELECT corporation_id FROM corporations ORDER BY corporation_id LIMIT 1);
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT balance FROM corp_accounts WHERE corp_id = @{tax_corporation_id}), 0);
UPDATE planets SET owner_type = 'corp', owner_id = @{tax_corporation_id} WHERE planet_id = @{corp_tax_planet_id};
INSERT INTO planet_tax_policies (planet_id, rate_bps, enabled) VALUES (@{corp_tax_planet_id}, 1000, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET rate_bps = 1000, enabled = TRUE;

tests.name: Clear isolated activity and current assessment for corporate test planet

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE planet_id = @{corp_tax_planet_id};

tests.name: Clear current assessment for corporate test planet

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_tax_assessments WHERE planet_id = @{corp_tax_planet_id} AND tax_date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;

INSERT INTO planet_economic_activity (planet_id, activity_type, commodity_code, quantity, unit_value, taxable_value, idempotency_key) VALUES (@{corp_tax_planet_id}, 'market_trade', 'ORE', 10, 1000, 10000, 'v2-taxation-e2e-corp-planet');

tests.name: Run daily tax cron for corporate colony

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'daily_planet_tax';

tests.name: Verify corporation receives the daily colony tax

data.sql: SELECT ca.balance - @{corp_credits_before}, tx.amount, ta.tax_amount, ta.taxable_value FROM corp_accounts ca JOIN corp_tx tx ON tx.corp_id = ca.corp_id AND tx.idempotency_key = 'planet-tax-receipt:' || @{corp_tax_planet_id} || ':' || (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::text JOIN planet_tax_assessments ta ON ta.planet_id = @{corp_tax_planet_id} AND ta.tax_date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date WHERE ca.corp_id = @{tax_corporation_id};
